hooks.command: if [ -f .tmp/session-handover.md ]; then echo 'A handover from the previous session exists. Read it now and follow its "Next session" instructions before anything else:'; cat .tmp/session-handover.md; TS=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); mv .tmp/session-handover.md ".tmp/session-handover-$TS.md"; echo "(Handover consumed and archived to .tmp/session-handover-$TS.md — rename it back to session-handover.md to replay it.)"; fi
